app.name: Shatbli
app.tagline: Design your dream home with AI

home.hero_subtitle: Upload a photo of your space and let our AI show you the possibilities with new ceramics and colors. No designer needed.
home.how_subtitle: Follow these steps to transform your room instantly without any technical skills.
home.step1_desc: Take a clear photo of your room or upload an existing one.
home.step2_desc: Select ceramics, colors, and textures from our gallery.
home.step3_desc: Our smart AI redraws your room with the new materials.
home.step4_desc: Compare results side-by-side and download your favorite.
home.gallery_subtitle: See how Shatbli transforms ordinary rooms into masterpieces.
home.after_desc: Marble textures generated by Shatbli AI.
home.features_subtitle: Designed to save you time, money, and stress.
home.feature1_desc: Avoid costly renovation mistakes by visualizing before you buy any materials.
home.feature2_desc: Get professional-grade renders in seconds, not days. No waiting for designers.
home.feature3_desc: Confident choices mean a happier renovation process for you and your family.
home.feature4_desc: Access hundreds of ceramic textures and paint colors in our database.
home.feature5_desc: Use Shatbli on your desktop or mobile browser. No heavy software installation.
home.feature6_desc: Full support for Arabic language and localized content.
home.review1_text: Shatbli saved me from buying tiles that would have looked terrible in my kitchen. The visualization was spot on!
home.review2_text: Incredibly easy to use. I just uploaded a photo and clicked generate. The results helped me convince my spouse on the color.
home.review3_text: The AI is very impressive. It kept the lighting of my room perfectly while changing the floor. Highly recommended!
home.cta_subtitle: Experience the magic of AI design with our free plan. Need high-resolution downloads? Check out our Pro plans.
